acme-corp/widget-sdk#42.title: Timeout when uploading files larger than 10MB
acme-corp/widget-sdk#42.body:
### Description

Uploads fail with a timeout once the file exceeds roughly 10MB. Smaller files are fine.

### Steps to reproduce

1. `pip install widget-sdk==3.2.1`
2. `client.upload(open('big.bin','rb'))` with a 12MB file
3. Wait ~30 seconds

### Actual behaviour

```
widget_sdk.errors.UploadTimeout: no response after 30000ms
```

### Expected behaviour

The upload completes, or the client streams the body instead of buffering it.

### Environment

- widget-sdk 3.2.1
- Python 3.11.6
- macOS 14.2

comments_data.body: Confirmed on Ubuntu 22.04 with the same version. Looks like the whole body is read into memory before the request goes out.

Workaround for now: chunk the file manually and call `upload_part`. Slow but it works.
